Messages.Author: Analnatrach
Messages.Body:
The other day we had a very close game :
This was the setting : My prey has 1 pool left and is contesting
Pentex with me, he brought out Esmeralda last turn.

Now it is the beginning of his turn , what happens ?

A : He has to pay for pentex first, can't (because he is on 1 pool )
has to sack penetex to stay alive, then can he sack esmeralda to gain
11 pool
B : He first sacks Esmeralda , gaining 11 pool, then he pays for
Pentex (or gives it up)

Both effects happen during untap, but I argued that mandatory things
go first (paying the contested card) BEFORE he can do anything else
(like sacking esmeralda to gain pool) ?

what is correct here ?

greetings,

Steve

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He orders the events as he likes. See section [4] of the rules.
B is allowed. He can choose A if he likes.
